title: Red panda dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='28' ry='7' fill='#1a3a2a' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- tail (fluffy, striped) -->
  <path d='M72 68 Q88 60 86 45 Q84 34 76 38 Q70 42 72 50 Q74 56 66 62' fill='#cc4422' stroke='#e8845a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M78 40 Q82 42 83 48' fill='none' stroke='#f5a060' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 52 Q80 54 80 59' fill='none' stroke='#f5a060' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- left leg (raised - dancing) -->
  <path d='M38 72 Q34 80 30 78 Q27 76 29 72' fill='#8b3311' stroke='#b05020' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='75' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#442211'/>
  
  <!-- right leg (standing) -->
  <path d='M56 72 Q58 82 60 86 Q62 89 58 89' fill='#8b3311' stroke='#b05020' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='87' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#442211'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#cc4422'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f5a060'/>
  
  <!-- left arm (raised, dancing) -->
  <path d='M36 54 Q26 44 22 36 Q20 32 24 30' fill='#cc4422' stroke='#e8845a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='30' r='4' fill='#442211'/>
  
  <!-- right arm (out to side) -->
  <path d='M64 54 Q74 48 78 42' fill='#cc4422' stroke='#e8845a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='41' r='4' fill='#442211'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#cc4422'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='26' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#cc4422'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='26' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#f5a060'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='26' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#cc4422'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='26' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#f5a060'/>
  
  <!-- face white markings -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f5e6d0'/>
  <path d='M38 36 Q42 33 46 36' fill='#f5e6d0'/>
  <path d='M54 36 Q58 33 62 36' fill='#f5e6d0'/>
  
  <!-- eye patches (dark) -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='38' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#5a2a10'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='38' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#5a2a10'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='37.5' r='1' fill='#1a0a05'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='37.5' r='1' fill='#1a0a05'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#331108'/>
  
  <!-- mouth (happy smile) -->
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 50 54 47' fill='none' stroke='#331108' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- cheeks (blush) -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff8888' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff8888' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- music notes (dancing!) -->
  <g fill='#66ffcc'>
    <path d='M82 22 Q84 18 84 24 L84 32 Q82 30 80 31 Q78 32 79 34 Q81 35 83 33 L83 25' fill='#66ffcc'/>
    <circle cx='80.5' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#66ffcc'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#66ffcc'>
    <path d='M14 42 Q16 38 16 44 L16 50 Q14 48 12 49 Q10 50 11 52 Q13 53 15 51 L15 45' fill='#66ffcc'/>
    <circle cx='12.5' cy='51' r='2' fill='#66ffcc'/>
  </g>
</svg>
